title.value: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to product safety
title.provenance: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to product safety.

reference.provenance: Assembly Bill No. 652, Friedman. Product safety: juvenile products: chemicals: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.

status.provenance: Approved by Governor October 5, 2021. Filed with Secretary of State October 5, 2021.

date.provenance: Approved by Governor October 5, 2021. Filed with Secretary of State October 5, 2021.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: On and after July 1, 2023, a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer, shall not sell or distribute in commerce in this state any new, not previously owned, juvenile product that contains regulated PFAS chemicals.

who.provenance: a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer

action.provenance: shall not sell or distribute in commerce

products.provenance: any new, not previously owned, juvenile product

value: internal component of a juvenile product that would not come into direct contact with a child's skin or mouth during reasonably foreseeable use and abuse of the product
exceptions.provenance: Juvenile product' does not include any of the following: (B) A medical device. (C) An internal component of a juvenile product that would not come into direct contact with a child's skin or mouth during reasonably foreseeable use and abuse of the product. (D) An adult mattress.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: No mention of 'currently unavoidable use' in the document.

intentionally_added.provenance: Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'regulated PFAS' means either of the following: (1) PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product, including, but not limited to, the PFAS components of intentionally added chemicals and PFAS that are intentional breakdown products of an added chemical that also have a functional or technical effect in the product.

type.provenance: A manufacturer shall use the least toxic alternative when replacing PFAS chemicals in a juvenile product in accordance with this chapter.

date.provenance: No specific date for this regulation is mentioned.

action.provenance: use the least toxic alternative when replacing PFAS chemicals

exceptions.provenance: No exceptions are mentioned for this regulation.
